heading: Management plan

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Not later than 3 years after March 12, 2019, in accordance with subsections (b) and (c), the Secretary shall develop a comprehensive plan for the long-term management of the Scenic Area.

tree.heading: Consultation
tree.text: In developing the management plan, the Secretary shall consult with—

children.text: appropriate State, Tribal, and local governmental entities, including Inyo County and the Tribe;
utilities, including Southern California Edison Company and the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power;
the Alabama Hills Stewardship Group; and

tree.heading: Requirement
tree.text: In accordance with this subchapter, the management plan shall include provisions for maintenance of existing public utility and other rights-of-way within the Scenic Area.

tree.heading: Incorporation
tree.text: In developing the management plan, in accordance with this section, the Secretary may allow casual use mining limited to the use of hand tools, metal detectors, hand-fed dry washers, vacuum cleaners, gold pans, small sluices, and similar items.

tree.heading: Interim management
tree.text: Pending completion of the management plan, the Secretary shall manage the Scenic Area in accordance with section 460ffff–1(b) of this title.

notes.heading: Definitions
notes.text: For definition of “Secretary” as used in this section, see section 3 of Pub. L. 103–433, set out as a note under section 410aaa of this title.
